about: The Worca Rail design system as data: what a page can be built from, for a tool or an agent. The rules are docs/design-system.md › Worca Rail (Which component, Where things go); when this file and that section differ, the section wins and this file is fixed in the same change. Components are the Design System artifact's pages.
howToBuild: For each thing the person must see or do, find its need below; use that component in that pattern's slot.
Write the words by the rules in docs/design-system.md: state words, labels of 1–3 words, failures as `Could not …`, the reason, `Nothing changed.`
Draw every state: empty, loading, could not load, a failed step, an unexpected break, a lost connection, and 375px.
Set no look of your own: no size, colour, corner or shadow; they come with the component.

Lay it out narrow by docs/design-system.md › Narrow screens: at 520px of content side by side stacks on the same text edge, the action slot moves under the state word and its extra buttons fold into ⋯; nothing is dropped; names keep one line with an ellipsis and a tooltip.
Pass the gate: plans/rail/prototype/ds-check.mjs and the page's sweep.

components.name: StatusLine
needs: the one next step of a state
parts: action slot: Button primary with ▾ for alternatives
components.notFor: a second primary; buttons for the page in the top bar

components.name: Button
components.notFor: going somewhere (Text link); on or off (Switch)

components.name: CompactMenu
needs: the alternatives of a split button
rules: opened from ⋯ or ▾
danger last, after a rule

components.name: ConfirmStrip
components.place: under the top bar, in place
rules: for a step that changes what other people see (a PR, a branch, a merge, a comment) or cannot be taken back; never for spending alone
opens on the safe choice
names what goes
near a limit, a step that starts agent work adds the limit note in one line
components.notFor: a step that needs fields (Dialog); a step that can be undone (act, then Undo in a Toast)

components.name: Dialog
needs: a step that needs fields first

components.name: Text link
needs: going to another page or place

components.name: SentencePicker
needs: a choice that changes a step
rules: sits in the sentence it changes
opens a CompactMenu
on a page it takes effect at once; a failed change flips back and a Toast says why; in a Dialog it applies on submit

components.name: OptionList
components.notFor: any other single choice (SentencePicker or Segmented)

components.name: Switch
needs: a setting that is on or off
rules: takes effect at once, no confirm
a failed change flips back and a Toast says why

components.name: Segmented
needs: two or three views of the same thing
components.example: Light and Dark; Summaries and Raw

components.name: Tabs
rules: each tab is in the address
a count is a caption

components.name: Chip
needs: a short fact: a stage, a source, a slot to set up
components.example: Beta, Official, No API key; Running 4

components.name: Field
needs: text, a number, a pick from a long list in a form
rules: 32px
its error is a line under it

components.name: SuggestionField
parts: grey line when it could not

components.name: Stepper
needs: how far along, and its steps
parts: StepRows of the open stage on the rail

components.name: Figures
rules: each opens its own detail
numbers only

components.name: TagGroup
rules: one line, the rest in +N
one button opens the ListEditor

components.name: ListRow
parts: state mark on the rail (dot, or tick box while selecting)
time or figure at the right
rules: divided rows, never a box per item
the whole row opens its one target

components.name: Toast
variants: warn and error: stay until closed; a repeat counts on it
rules: title at most 6 words
never moves focus
Undo for a step that can be taken back

components.name: EmptyState
needs: a part of the page cannot be drawn
rules: one line on the text edge
loading: nothing for 300ms, then one line; never a spinner or skeleton
could not load: Could not load …, the reason, Nothing changed., Try again, Details
a part that cannot be drawn: Could not show …, Reload this part, Details
empty: its one sentence, and the way forward as one quiet action
components.example: No runs yet; Could not show the changes

telling.place: where you acted: the strip, the dialog's alert, the field's error line, the suggestion's grey line; a Toast only when there is no such place
a quiet line at the end of the top bar, grey dot: Offline · retrying; then a Toast: Back online

patterns.name: A thing's page
patterns.for: any page about one thing with a state: a run, a group
slots: top bar: trail; at its right only the pager and the connection line
title
metadata line: facts as phrases, then TagGroup; a fact that is also a setting is a SentencePicker in its phrase
StatusLine with the action slot and ⋯ (empty slot when the state calls for no step)
progress: Stepper and StepRows; questions as OptionList under their step
Figures
Tabs

patterns.name: A list page
slots: top bar: trail
title row with the page's one action at its right (New schedule)
A list

patterns.name: A list
slots: the sentence of what it shows (SentencePicker), replaced by the selection bar while selecting
sections in a fixed order, empty sections not drawn
ListRows; a fact in a row is text, never a second link; the row's own actions in a ⋯ at its right end
EmptyState when empty

patterns.name: A panel
slots: under its top-bar button, over any page
head: Tabs with counts as captions, ⋯ at the right
body that scrolls under a head that stays

patterns.name: A settings tab
slots: title
Tabs
one meta line: what the tab decides
sections on one rail; a row is its name and one sentence with a SentencePicker or a Switch
Customise folds detail under a row
a reset in its section's head, confirmed in the strip

patterns.name: A form
slots: Dialog
the one framing sentence with SentencePickers
Fields and SuggestionFields
a problem note on the rail with an amber dot, its ways out as buttons
foot: Cancel (quiet), then the start button naming what happens

actions.kind: the one step the state calls for
actions.slot: the action slot's main; alternatives in its ▾; Stop or Cancel last, after a rule

actions.kind: supporting actions on the whole thing
actions.slot: ⋯ next to the action slot; tools, then Report, then Archive or Delete after a rule
that section's head, at its right
the fact itself, as a Figure or Text link; ⋯ only when no fact names it

actions.kind: a yes or no, or a one-line answer
a choice that changes a step
actions.slot: SentencePicker in the sentence it changes

actions.kind: a list on a thing's page that is part of a step (checks, a plan)
actions.slot: one line on its StepRow (a count and the names that matter); the whole list in Overview's first section, the state's focus (What broke, The plan)

actions.kind: a list about the thing as a whole (files, decisions, activity)
actions.slot: its own tab, the count a caption on the tab; never also in the card

actions.kind: a thing's own setting (a schedule's times, a run's budget)
actions.slot: the fact itself where the page shows it, as a SentencePicker; settings that must change together: a Dialog from ⋯ (Edit schedule…); where it belongs (its group): ⋯
Settings; a thing's own settings are the thing's
a ⋯ at the row's right end
